meta.dataset: CityMETER Restaurants — public overlay snapshot with research enrichment
meta.sourceOfRecord: Research sheet “CityMETER Restaurants Thailand — Source Audit & Refresh Master 2026-10-22” (internal; tabs 02_STORES, 01_BRANDS, 07_VENUES)
meta.sourceLimitation: Provider and scrape date are absent from public exposure. Do not infer Google provenance solely from rating/field names.

coordinate.encoding: cols.gx/gy = global grid integers at z10 × extent 4096 (n = 4,194,304); lon = gx/n·360−180, lat = atan(sinh(π(1−2·gy/n))) — the research decoder formula; equals the sheet latitude/longitude within 5e-7°
coordinate.note: display position, not the source coordinate

meta.keyEncoding: cols.key = first 12 hex digits of snapshot_observation_id (R-<24 hex>-<ordinal>), plus -NN when the ordinal is not 01; unique in this snapshot
meta.tileRule: every row comes from the z10 overlay tile that contains its display coordinate (checked at build time)
meta.brandRule: brand = explicit source-name chain candidate (01_BRANDS); not a verified branch relationship
meta.venueRule: venue = explicit source-name host candidate (07_VENUES); not a verified located-inside relationship
